additional_concerns: Both format claims incorrectly describe footnote 3 as missing. Unit da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 states: "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." The method-listing propositions are supported, but the extracted conditions do not establish complete permissions. The NOT_ESTABLISHED assessments below concern those incomplete conditions, not whether the methods are listed.

The XML extraction also omits schema compliance and the transitional duty to liaise with JFIU to arrange a technical test. The source does not expressly make successful completion of a technical test a prerequisite to every XML submission; adding that restriction would require support.

The prescribed PDF STR form and separately provided JFIU XML schema are missing. They are needed for detailed compliance assessment, but not to establish that the circular lists those methods. NONE_DECLARED below uses this narrower authority scope; it does not resolve the prior disagreement if the claims are intended to determine complete submission compliance. No supplied dependency ID can reliably be assigned to either document.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 uses "[the fact filing_date] is greater than or equal to [date value 2026-02-02]", covering the pre-9:00am portion of that date. The source separately states "With effect from 2 February 2026" and "upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026", while the trigger says "following its implementation". Preserve the competing date and operational-launch readings; none of these unrelated claim checks resolves them.

The other candidates select the operational-launch reading. The governing timezone and treatment of the exact implementation boundary remain unresolved. An authoritative JFIU or SFC clarification is not supplied and has no identifiable dependency ID.

The blackout provision authorizes urgent direct contact, without establishing that every contact is a submission or that a genuine submission through such contact is excluded. Automatic migration of earlier records is separately described and should not itself create a new original submission.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb tests actual submission in its result; the other event candidates place it in scope. Consequently, non-submission events can yield FALSE in the former and OUT_OF_SCOPE in the latter. Their equivalence depends on the intended event domain.

The history candidate delegates event existence and evidential completeness to a supplied Boolean. Its formula does not inspect histories. A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase a historical trigger; historical trigger existence does not establish that the duty remains outstanding.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must retain the typed DUTY_TRIGGER meaning: TRUE identifies a trigger, not completion of resubmission. Extraction defects in format permissions do not automatically establish executable defects in these trigger formulas. These assessments neither authorize pruning nor establish overall candidate correctness.
